title: docs: revamp agent integration guide for MCP and Claude Desktop
body:
### Summary
This PR introduces a comprehensive documentation overhaul focused on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration. The primary goal is to surface existing but hidden agentic capabilities to users, allowing them to bridge the gap between a static prompt library and active AI agent workflows.

### The "Why"
Previously, users had no clear path to discover or configure the repository's MCP capabilities within the root documentation. This created a friction point where the "Prompt Library" remained a passive resource rather than a tool for agents. By centralizing technical setup and providing clear discovery paths in the `README` and `Quickstart` guides, we empower users to integrate these prompts directly into standard clients like Claude Desktop without external support.

### Key Changes

#### 1. New Technical Guide: `docs/mcp_integration.md`
Created a centralized resource for technical setup, including:
- **Prerequisites:** Explicitly listed requirements (Python 3.10+, `mcp`, `watchdog`, `jsonschema`).
- **Claude Desktop Walkthrough:** Detailed instructions for connecting the local library as a toolset.
- **CLI Utilities:** Documented the `promptops agent config` command for JSON generation and `promptops agent discovery` for auditing prompt-to-tool mappings.

#### 2. Discovery & Onboarding Updates
To ensure 100% visibility, I updated the following entry points:
- **Root `README.md`**: Added an **Integrations** section to highlight agent support immediately.
- **`docs/QUICKSTART.md`**: Added "Agent Integration" as a logical next step after initial setup.
- **`docs/overview.md`**: Integrated the new guide into the essential documentation list.

#### 3. Maintenance & Validation
- Accounted for platform-specific pathing issues in configuration examples to prevent common setup errors on Windows vs. Unix.
- Verified all internal links using the `test_check_broken_links.py` suite to ensure a seamless navigation experience.

### Acceptance Criteria Progress
- [x] 'Integrations' section added to root README.
- [x] Quickstart points to agent integration.
- [x] Guide provides specific `promptops` commands for config generation.
- [x] Discovery command documented for tool auditing.
- [x] Dependencies (watchdog, etc.) clearly listed.
- [x] Verified zero broken links.

## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed. Please also include relevant motivation and context. If this is a new prompt or workflow, explain its intended persona and use case.

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New prompt/workflow (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation (`docs/`, `overview.md` if creating a new directory)
- [ ] I have run `./scripts/validate_prompts.sh` successfully and all checks pass locally
- [ ] If submitting a prompt: it follows `docs/template_prompt.prompt.yaml` schema
- [ ] If submitting a prompt: it includes realistic `testData` and `evaluators`
- [ ] If submitting a prompt: jinja variables are correctly formatted without spaces inside brackets (e.g. `{{var_name}}`)
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes

## Code Reuse Verification
- [ ] **Author**: Confirmed I searched directories `promptops/promptops/` and `studio/studio/` to reuse existing YAML/file parsing and UI list helpers (in `utils.py` & `helpers.py`) before submitting.
- [ ] **Reviewer**: Confirmed standard helper patterns are reused and no redundant utility or custom workflows were introduced.
